description: An eye that grew its own legs. It watched the whole fight from the floor, and it is still watching.
lore: Every stall that carries them carries a box with a lid, and the lid stays on while anyone at that stall is eating. Ask why and you get told bad luck, which is what the road says when it would rather not go into a thing. The plain reason is better. There are eight small eyes on the stalks and the big one in the middle, and they do not agree about where you are standing. A sorter works a bag for four hours at a stretch. Four hours is a long time to be got wrong by something on the table. Seventy-five gold, the dearest scrap off [[monsters/eldritch_maw|the ringed mouth]] that is not a stone, and every one of them travels face down.
gm_notes: The joke is the superstition; the turn is that the real reason is worse and entirely practical. Useful for establishing that crackers are workers with long shifts, not adventurers.
